card.name: Vowel pieces inside foreign proper names
card.fires_on: Vowel-ending pieces (u, ú, uu, au, wu) partway through or at the end of unusual proper names, mostly Native American, Hungarian or Gaelic names. Also the end of the brand name SOTYKTU.
